voice.rule: The firm speaks of itself as "the Firm", never "we", "our" or "us"; the client is "the Client". A document signed by someone else (a party's letter, consent or resolution, a power of attorney) speaks in that person's own voice.
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

spelling.rule: British spelling with -ise throughout: authorise, organisation, recognise, utilise, finalise; also colour, favour, labour, centre, defence, fulfil, instalment, programme, licence (noun), acknowledgement, cancelled, judgment (of a court).

defined_terms.rule: A term is defined once, in bold inside brackets, without quotation marks, and used with the same capitals ever after. In a definitions clause the term is bold without quotation marks, followed by "means" or the pointer formula.
defined_terms.pointer_formula: shall have the meaning ascribed thereto in Section [●] ([●])
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

numbers.rule: Counts, periods and percentages in words then figures, the words in lower case with no hyphen. Figures in brackets are never zero-padded: five (5), not five (05).
examples: one hundred and twenty five percent (125%)
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

money.rule: The currency code, the figure with thousands separators and "/-", then the amount in words in Title Case in brackets on first mention; the figure alone thereafter. Inside a standard, follow the wording already in the slot.
examples: USD 118,750,000/- (United States Dollars One Hundred Eighteen Million Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Only)
variants: no "/-" in the Concession Agreement master's slots
"Pakistan Rupees" (MM68) is a slip for Pakistani Rupees
source: plan: How it will work: the wording
PQE4.3, AM7, PI45 (USD and PKR fee forms)

dates.rule: Month in words, the day as two figures, a comma, the year in full; no "th". In an agreement's preamble the formula "on this [●] day of [●], [●]" is kept.

placeholder.rule: Every unknown is [●] (a bracketed black circle). A neutral bracketed description is allowed where a reader needs to know what goes there: [relevant sales tax authority], [applicable PPP law]. No [•], [ ], [____] or XX.
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

cross_refs.rule: A reference to a provision of the same document carries its heading in brackets the first time it is made in a clause.
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

headings.rule: Headings in Title Case, the firm capitalising small words too (Grant Of Rights, Scope Of Work); the numbering is Word's own, never typed.
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

obligations.rule: "shall" for an obligation, "may" for a discretion; never "will" for an obligation in an agreement.
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

statutes.rule: An Act is cited by its name, a comma and its year: Companies Act, 2017; Contract Act, 1872; Arbitration Act, 1940. A section of a statute is lower case (section 197); a section of the document is capitalised (Section 5.4).
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

government.rule: No government, province, provincial department or body, and no province-specific or federal-only PPP law, is named. The government party is the defined term Government, named once where it is defined in a deal's draft; departments and authorities are [●] or a neutral description in brackets. Nationwide laws and bodies stay (Companies Act, 2017; SECP; Arbitration Act, 1940; Contract Act, 1872; FBR).
source: Decisions 20 Oct 2026 (no government or province is built in)

parties_close.text: …(the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns)
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

banned.reason: The firm defines a party as (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns), not "(hereinafter referred to as …". The roll-up "are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties" is the firm's own.
"WITNESSETH" is another firm's formula; the firm heads its recitals "Recitals" and closes them with "Now, Therefore, … the Parties hereby agree as follows:".
The firm speaks as "the Firm", never "we", "our" or "us".
An obligation in an agreement takes "shall", not "will".
source: plan: How it will work: the wording

tells_of_counterparty.tell: Defined terms in quotation marks: (the "Company"), "Agreement" means …
source: plan: How it will work: the wording
